index.title: Reconcile Bexio contacts
index.content: This shows all persons, organizations and members of the main organization next to the contacts in Bexio. «Sync» loads the contacts from Bexio and compares them with the entries in the app. If a contact is missing on one side, you can add it from its row.

error.credentials: Bexio rejected the access. The access key has to be renewed. Until then the Bexio columns stay empty.
error.fetch: The Bexio contacts could not be loaded. The Bexio columns stay empty.
